decision: Read PROJECT.md (AGENTS.md) and skill-deck.toml as first sources of truth
reason: Zero-knowledge subagent. Must bootstrap all understanding from workdir files. PROJECT.md is the project's core context document per CLAUDE.md's redirect. skill-deck.toml shows current skill configuration.

decision: Read lythoskill-deck SKILL.md (the only innate skill)
reason: The deck skill is the irreducible dependency. Understanding it unlocks the entire project's architecture: cold pool, working set, deck link, skill types, seed bootstrap pattern.

decision: Read reference files: glossary.md, architecture.md, skill-types.md
reason: The SKILL.md points to these as supporting references. Need to understand niche, silent blend, thickness layers, cold pool conventions, and the distinction between deck sections vs SKILL.md types.

decision: Identify four additional skills needed: project-onboarding, project-scribe, project-cortex, curator
reason: AGENTS.md documents these as the project's own skill set. Onboarding (session start), scribe (session end), cortex (governance), curator (discovery) form the minimal viable set for working on this project. Arena and coach left for later as task-dependent.

decision: Attempt deck add from GitHub → fails due to network restriction
reason: deck add tries to clone from github.com which is unreachable in this sandbox. Error: 'Cannot reach https://github.com/lythos-labs/lythoskill.git'. LYTHOS_SOCKS_PROXY not configured.

decision: Attempt deck add from localhost/ → fails with invalid locator
reason: Skills exist at github.com/lythos-labs/lythoskill/skills/ in cold pool, not under localhost/. The localhost/ prefix requires skills to be organized under that cold pool path.

decision: Hand-edit skill-deck.toml to declare tool skills, then run deck link to reconcile
reason: Network-restricted environment prevents deck add (git clone). Skills already exist in cold pool at correct paths. The deck skill's own documentation shows agent-assisted deck building where the agent edits the toml. deck link resolves from cold pool without network.

decision: Run deck validate before link to check toml format
reason: Validation passed (5 skills, max_cards=10). Detected content drift on lythoskill-curator (SKILL.md hash changed since last add) — expected for a skill declared manually rather than via deck add.

decision: Run deck link to reconcile working set from cold pool
reason: deck link successfully created symlinks for all 5 skills: lythoskill-deck, lythoskill-project-onboarding, lythoskill-project-scribe, lythoskill-project-cortex, lythoskill-curator. All resolved from cold pool without network.

decision: Verify working set with ls and read newly linked skill SKILL.md files
reason: Confirmed all 5 symlinks present. Read each new skill's SKILL.md to verify their purposes align with the analysis: onboarding (read-side CQRS), scribe (write-side CQRS), cortex (GTD governance with CLI-only transitions), curator (dumb indexer, smart agent).

Final deliverable. understanding.md covers: project identity, key concepts (cold pool/working set/deck/deny-by-default/skill types/phase decks/seed bootstrap/cortex/handoff/arena), workflows, skills added with rationale, and architecture principles. decision-log.jsonl records each decision phase with timestamp and reasoning.
